question: Scarlet Witch, Chaotic Avenger ({2}{U}{R} legendary 3/3 flier: on combat damage to a player, exile the top two and cast a Hero or noncreature spell among them free) in -- and for what?

A hit: 40 of 98 library cards are castable (38 noncreature, 2 Hero creatures); the top two hold at least one about 65% of the time (hand-computed). Many whiff off a combat trigger: Counterspell and Mana Drain have no target, the protection instants do little after damage, Shark Typhoon free is X=0, the rocks are small. Real hits, by count 19 (the wheels, Big Score, Fiery Emancipation, Rhystic, Tithe, Ageless Insight, Teferi, Delayed Blast Fireball cast from exile, Collective Defiance, Prismari, Monument, Banishing Light, Swords, Get Lost, Chaos Warp, Shang-Chi, Valeria): about 35% of connections. Misses stay exiled for later triggers. All of it rides on a 4-mana 3/3 connecting at a table that races the deck: the Rain of Riches pattern, a conditional free spell, and roughly one good free spell per three connections does not clearly beat the floor.
